full_judgment:
2. Before entering into the merit of the appeal it is to be noted that the petition for special leave to appeal was barred by 146 days. The question of limitation was left open at the time of granting leave to be decided at the time of hearing of the appeal. 

 3. The judgment in which the impugned remarks were passed was delivered on 16.7.69 but the petition for special leave was filed en 8.1.70; It was stated in the petition for special leave that the appellant learnt about the impugned remarks from the issue of the Dacca Law Reports dated 16th November, 1969 and from that date the petition was within time. Before us no argument, as a matter of fact, was made on the question of limitation, but as the matter was heard by us, it will be deemed that the delay was condoned.
